vulnerabilities.weakness: Stateful emptyDir volume with no PVC; data lost on pod restart, breaking cart persistence
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the redis-cart pod restarts, all cart data is lost, causing checkout failures
vulnerabilities.severity_raised_by_code: high → critical (stateful without a persistent volume: a restart loses data)

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica entrypoint with no PDB or HPA, so a pod failure brings down the entire site
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the frontend pod crashes, the site becomes unavailable to all users

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica checkout orchestrator with no PDB or HPA, failure stops all checkout flows
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the checkoutservice pod dies, all checkout requests fail

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica catalog; failure stops product data during checkout
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the productcatalogservice pod crashes, checkout cannot fetch product details and fails

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica payment processor; failure blocks payment completion
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the paymentservice pod crashes, payment attempts fail and orders cannot be completed

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica cart service; failure prevents cart retrieval during checkout
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the cartservice pod dies, checkout cannot read the cart and fails

systemic: All services run a single replica with no PDB or HPA, exposing the cluster to single‑point failures; none of the services use persistent volumes for stateful data, so pod restarts lose data
blind_spots: The facts do not reveal whether services implement retries, timeouts, or circuit breakers; they also omit any rate‑limiting or back‑pressure mechanisms that could mitigate cascading failures
